image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a grey whale surfacing in teal ocean water. The whale's head and anterior body are visible, showing characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. A portion of a blue and yellow boat is visible in the bottom left corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The angle is from the side/front; the top of the head where blowholes are located is not clearly visible or is obscured by the water line and perspective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly shows the characteristic mottling and white callosities/barnacle patches typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only shows the head and shoulders; the posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior section is visible; the full spindle shape cannot be verified from this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; the visible skin matches the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed; baleen plates are internal and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located further back on the body and are submerged/out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution details show the rough, bumpy texture associated with callosities.

The geometry of the boat is ambiguous; the yellow and blue sections blend without clear structural definition or realistic reflection/refraction at the waterline.
